visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair is sitting in bed, leaning against the headboard and using a laptop on her lap. She looks slightly uncomfortable. (2) The scene shifts to her at a wooden dining table in a bright, modern room, again hunched over a laptop. (3) She is seen lying on a yoga mat in front of a large window with lush green mountains outside, using a foam roller on her back. (4) Sitting on a white sofa in a striped green shirt, she rubs her neck and shoulder with a pained expression. (5) She speaks directly to the camera in a close-up shot, wearing a grey tank top and a thin necklace. (6) A montage shows her working out in a gym on various machines like lat pull-downs and pull-ups, highlighting her back muscles. (7) She demonstrates using a black massage ball against a white wall to relieve tension in her shoulder. (8) She returns to her desk, stacking books under her laptop to bring it to eye level and showing off a pink ergonomic keyboard and white vertical mouse. (9) Detailed shots of the Logitech Lift mouse and Wave Keys keyboard are shown in various colors, along with a 3D printing process of a mouse shell. (10) She is seen happily typing on the new setup with a much straighter posture. (11) Final shot of her smiling and waving in front of the window.

(2) The music continues as she describes her experience with pain despite exercise; the vocal energy remains steady but empathetic. (3) A soft 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of variety text on screen. (4) Narration shifts to advice on stretching and workspace setup; the speech rate is moderate and professional. (5) As she introduces the Logitech products, the music remains constant, but short digital UI 'whoosh' sounds punctuate transitions between product features. (6) Subtle clicking sounds from the mouse are barely audible, emphasizing its 'silent' feature mentioned in the narration. (7) The video concludes with her upbeat farewell and the music fading out quickly after a final high-energy phrase.
